- Published accept-set: unchanged, right. No schema, no export and no runtime code of `@objectstack/spec` moves; the hunk in `protocol-version.ts` is four comment lines above `PROTOCOL_VERSION`, and the constant stays `'19.0.0'`.

- Source of the stamp: changed from the scaffolder's package major to `PROTOCOL_MAJOR`, right. This is what ruling 7194715376 (Q1 C as its own card) and the card's scope item 1 order, and it is the export `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts` already stamps from (lines 1020, 1210, 1347). The `@objectstack/*` dependency half still takes the scaffolder's exact version, right: the ruling moves the protocol range only.
- Repo-script surface: `scripts/sync-template-versions.mjs` gains the exports `PROTOCOL_SOURCE` and `loadProtocolMajor()`; no existing export is removed or renamed; the callback argument of the `engines.protocol` row of `TEXT_STAMPS` changes from `major` to `protocolMajor`, and its only caller is `main()` in the same file. The other importers (`release.yml` reading `stampedPaths()`, `sync-scaffold-emission-policy.mjs` reading `TEMPLATE_DIR`, `TEMPLATE_PKG_FILE`, `findTemplateDirs`) use none of the changed members. Right.
- New refusal: the stamper exits 1 and writes nothing when the constant cannot be read (missing file, a Node without `module.stripTypeScriptTypes`, a non-integer export). Right, and required by the card's premise clause (no fallback to the package major).
- Consistency test: the template range is now held to `PROTOCOL_MAJOR`, no longer to the package major. Right; it is the card's scope item 2 and second acceptance line. Nothing else in the tree still holds the template range to the package major (`ownMajor` has no remaining reader; typecheck is green).
- Gate verdicts on this head: 58 success, 17 skipped, 1 failure. The derived families for these paths are green: Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Test Core 1/10 to 10/10, Type Check · workspace and source gates, Spec property liveness, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard. The one failure is answered in ③.

### ② Semver level

No changeset, `skip-changeset` label, Check Changeset green. That matches what the diff publishes: nothing. The only hunk inside a published package's shipped source is a docblock; the other three files are a repo script and two test files that no package ships. The dev dropped the earlier `create-objectstack` patch changeset after merging `main`, because the template change it described no longer exists in the diff; that is the correct reading of the tree.

Clause-②: no — correct. No existing project, package or caller is refused or behaves differently: the published template carries the same range, and the stamper's new refusal can only fire inside this repository's own version pass.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions` of the final dev report 7198725762: empty. The one question of the blocked report 7197758207 (widen the surface by `template-version-stamps.test.ts`) was answered by claim amendment 7197818926, option A, fixture setup only; the diff of that file is 15 added lines, no assertion touched, which is inside the amendment.
- Deviation 1, the stamper evaluates the TypeScript source instead of importing the built `@objectstack/spec/kernel`: accepted. Read against the tree, both stated reasons hold: the root `version` script runs `sync-protocol-version.mjs` before this script and that script rewrites the constant in source, so only the source is current at stamp time; and the card forbids a `release.yml` edit, so no build can be added to the lane. The card names the constant in `protocol-version.ts` as the source, not the built package.
- Deviation 2, changeset dropped: accepted, see ②.
- Deviation 3 (model-free commit trailers) and 4 (first round stopped at the breach): no contract bearing.
- Fence: no path under `.github/workflows/**` or `docker/**` is in the diff. Held.
- Version-pass rehearsal (third acceptance line): reported green by the dev on this head (15/15 content gates, `VALIDATE_EXIT=0`). It is the dev's measurement, not a check-run, and it was not re-run here. Read against the tree it is plausible: the lane needs no `dist/`, the stamper's own fixtures carry their own constant, and `create-objectstack`'s vitest config already aliases `@objectstack/spec/kernel` to source.
- Red check `Scaffold with repo dist` (not a required context): nothing in this diff bears on it. The job log on this head shows the registry install failing with ETARGET for `@objectstack/cli@19.0.0-next.0` (not yet published), the job's own fallback installing `latest` (18.x) and re-stamping to `^18`, then `objectstack validate` refusing the template's `color` key under the 18.x runtime. The template's bytes are identical to `main`'s, so `main` reds the same way; the job ran here only because two test files under `packages/create-objectstack/**` match its path filter. It is the red #37441 (PR #37655) carries, and this PR neither causes nor cures it.
- Fourth acceptance line (#37441's `Restart-when:`): its probe was already met on `main` by #35129; this merge does not change it.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/kernel/protocol-version.ts` (hits). The new sentence makes three claims; each was read against the tree.
- "stamped from `PROTOCOL_MAJOR` itself (`scripts/sync-template-versions.mjs`...)": true. `loadProtocolMajor()` strips the types of this very file and imports the result, then reads the module's `PROTOCOL_MAJOR` export; the `engines.protocol` row writes `^` plus that value. It evaluates the export, so a later change to how the major is derived is followed without touching the script.
- "as `os init` does": true, same export, read there through `@objectstack/spec/kernel`.
- "so it moves in the change that moves the constant (create-objectstack's consistency test reds until it does)": true as enforced. The stamper itself runs at the version pass, so the move is forced by the test, as the parenthesis says: `template-consistency.test.ts` compares every template's range to `PROTOCOL_MAJOR`, resolved to source by the package's vitest alias, and `create-objectstack#test` depends on the spec build in turbo, so a spec-only change re-runs it. The first consumer, the scenario the card was filed on (constant at N+1 while packages are on N), now reds on the pull request that moves the constant and tells the author which script to run.
- Attempt to break it at the version pass: `sync-protocol-version.mjs` may set the constant back to the spec package's major; the stamper runs after it and reads the rewritten source, so the published template and the published runtime always name the same major. Holds.

`scripts/sync-template-versions.mjs` (implementing).
- Header and row comment agree with the code: the protocol range comes from `loadProtocolMajor()`, never from `loadScaffolderVersion().major`; `main()` no longer destructures `major`.
- Refusal before any write: both loads sit in one try block ahead of the template walk, so a failed read exits 1 with nothing stamped. Control K observes exactly that, and observes both directions with the two majors apart (42.6.0 against 43.0.0): a template at the protocol major is left unwritten, one at the package major is rewritten. Seven assertions, floor 7, roster floor 11; the fixture constant is derived, not literal, so a regex reader would not pass it.
- Import safety: the namespace import of `node:module` keeps the module linkable on a Node without the function, and the top-level `await main()` is inside the entry guard; every importer uses `import`, none uses `require`, so the async module is safe for them.
- Node floor: `.nvmrc` pins 22 and every lane that runs the script reads it; the self-test gate is green on this head.

`packages/create-objectstack/src/template-consistency.test.ts` (implementing). The case compares `Number(match[1])` to `PROTOCOL_MAJOR` for each bundled template and its message names the constant and the fix command. It agrees with the docblock sentence it enforces and with the card's second acceptance line.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Nits, left as accepted deviations (a fix would move the head):
- N1 (nit) — the root `package.json` declares Node 22.0.0 or later, while the stamper, its self-test and the stamps test now need 22.13. A contributor on 22.0 to 22.12 gets the named error, not a wrong stamp, and no CI lane is below the floor.
- N2 (nit) — the new sentence sits in the paragraph about protocol 19 and is written in the present tense; for 19 itself the template moved at the version pass (#35129), not in the change that moved the constant. The sentence is the rule from here on and is correct as such.
- N3 (nit) — each stamper run now prints one `ExperimentalWarning` line on stderr. Nothing in the tree parses stderr of this script; the PR body states the cost.
